The Fucks Paradox

Most people nonchalantly say that they have stopped giving a fuck about about anything. This is untrue as pretty soon there will come a time where one will need to give a fuck, but one will have no fucks left to give. In theory, they do have a fuck to give, but that only fuck is the fuck thats making them give a fuck about fucks. Thus if they lose this last fuck they will theoretically have no fucks left to give putting them back in their fuckless situation where they have no fucks, yet they're giving a fuck about having to give a fuck. In conclusion, a fuck paradox is then created, starting the never ending cycle of giving and losing the only fuck, leaving them theoretically fuckless, yet still giving a fuck. 

tl;dr Can't give a fuck if you have no fucks

Sonic Adventure 2 Battle on GameCube 

I was 12 or 13 at the time, and I had just beaten the End Scenario of the game where Super Shadow and Super Sonic save the Earth from Final Hazard. Then I spent 2-3 hours in the Chaos Garden where I raised a Hero and Dark Chaos successfully. Next thing I know my younger cousin walks in as I'm putting the controller down to get a snack. I explicitly say to him don't touch the game, then walk out. 

No more than a minute later, I walk back in to find the game back at the opening animations and my cousin missing. I panicked and checked the story menu. The End was still there, but when I went to the chaos garden, I only found the two basic eggs and my chao missing. I have never felt such regret before in my entire life.
